Historically, unpopular wars have always roiled the Democratic Party — and shaken up the party leadership.

The “Age of A.I.” could be an age of miracles and wonders — for a few. But it will not uplift the majority of humans by accident. It will require a real commitment to a “new deal” between technology companies and humanity.

There are two kinds of A.I. -- not just one.

We keep hearing about the A.I. known as "Artificial Intelligence." But there is an older A.I. that almost nobody talks about anyone. Call it "Ancient Intelligence." Or "Ancestral Intelligence." posts.text:
Black entrepreneurs changed the world with two turntables and a microphone. Hip-hop is now a global economy, a fashion industry and a language spoken by billions. What comes next will be bigger.

Private space exploration. Biotech. Quantum computing. AI. These are young industries, and the ground floor is still open.

If we show up for this moment, the next decade could generate more Black wealth than any period in American history.

What are you building?
